data.name: Malikul
data.gender_notes: Malikul is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A title of honor and rulership, symbolizing strength and leadership. The name Malikul carries the meaning “King of Kings” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Malikul usually hope their child will grow to embody king of kings and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Quranic context, Malikul means 'The King of Kings' and represents Allah's sovereignty.
data.etymology: Malikul belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “King of Kings.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Malikul total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: مليكل
in_arabic.long_meaning: مليكل هو اسم عربي مشتق من كلمة ملك، التي تعني الملك والسلطان، ويشير إلى من له السلطة والقيادة، وقد استخدم هذا الاسم في التاريخ الإسلامي لوصف الأمراء والملوك، وأيضا يستخدم في القرآن الكريم لوصف الله تعالى sebagai ملك الملك

in_urdu.name: ملکول
in_urdu.long_meaning: ملکول ایک عربی نام ہے جو ملك سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا معنی بادشاہ اور سلطان ہے، اور یہ نام اسلامی تاریخ میں شاہوں اور بادشاہوں کی وضاحت کے لیے استعمال ہوا ہے، اور قرآن مجید میں بھی اللہ تعالیٰ کی وضاحت کے لیے استعمال ہوا ہے

in_hindi.name: मलिकुल
in_hindi.long_meaning: मलिकुल एक अरबी नाम है जो मلك से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ राजा और सुल्तान है, और इस नाम का उपयोग इस्लामी इतिहास में राजाओं और सुल्तानों के वर्णन के लिए किया गया है, और कुरान में भी अल्लाह के वर्णन के लिए उपयोग किया गया है

in_pashto.name: ملکول

in_english.name: Malikul
in_english.long_meaning: Malikul is an Arabic name derived from the word malk, meaning King and Sultan, and refers to one who has authority and leadership, and has been used in Islamic history to describe princes and kings, and also in the Quran to describe Allah as the King of Kings

data.cultural_impact: The name "Malikul" is a title of honor and leadership, originating from the Arabic language. Malikul signifies a powerful and formidable figure, a ruler or king who commands respect and obedience. In Islamic and Arab culture, the title Malikul has been given to significant leaders and rulers throughout history.
data.spiritual_significance: Malikul also holds spiritual significance in Islam. The name represents strong, steadfast faith and submission to Allah. In Islamic theology, Allah is described as the "Malik Al-Mulk" or the "King of Kings," emphasizing His ultimate sovereignty and control over all things. By being called "Malikul," one is reminded of their dependence on Allah as their true King and Sustainer. Additionally, the name serves as a reminder for believers to strive for leadership roles in their communities and to lead with virtue, wisdom, and just governance.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "King of Kings" symbolizes A title of honor and rulership, symbolizing strength and leadership.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Malikul serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of king of kings.
